{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Cularin IV''''' was a [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] that was used by the [[Cularin Militia]]. In c. [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the Militia [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Gavin Bresch]] had the [[Heroes of Cularin]] transported to ''Cularin IV'' from [[Hedrett Public Transport Facility|Hedrett Groundport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], so that he could hire them to prevent the [[Believers]] from attacking a summit of [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] leaders.
